summary: Oneida County tower listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no build, staffing, fire, removal or site record found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no removal date found

evidence.supports: the Monico tower is listed in Oneida County at 45.59452, -89.22787 and marked as gone
the Central US Lookouts Monico page gives the county as Oneida County
Wisconsin decided in 2016 to close its last 72 operating fire lookout towers, a statewide fact not specific to this tower
evidence.quote: The state of Wisconsin decided to close its last 72 operating fire lookout towers in 2016.

notes_for_editor: Stub: the story is about 75 words, well under the 120-word floor. The Central US Lookouts Monico page has only a title and a county line, and its Wisconsin index entry gives only the county. No build, staffing, fire or removal record was found, and two WebSearch calls returned only the FFLA listing. The Wikipedia Monico community article was fetched and has no reference to a lookout tower. The Forest Service sources that might cover Oneida County towers returned HTTP 504 (fs.usda.gov); retry before deciding whether to publish a stub. The Monico AHI record (HI21143) is a house, not the tower; do not use it.
